newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to visit floods in Dakotas on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to visit floods in Dakotas on Tuesday.

text.p: President Clinton will visit flood-ravaged North Dakota Tuesday to inspect the damage, the White House said Monday.
It said Clinton would visit Grand Forks, which has been hit badly by the flooding.

This weekend, the Red River punched through clay dikes and swept into the North Dakota city. A devastating fire followed, tearing through the downtown business district as several feet of water kept firefighters from doing their job.

White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry said Clinton was monitoring the situation closely and was receiving frequent updates from James Lee Witt, the director of the Federal Emergency Management Agency.
"FEMA has got 500 people out there already and another 100 that are arriving shortly to deal with the flood damage," McCurry said.
"The president's been getting regular updates...(It's) Obviously a very difficult situation," McCurry said.
